integration: Native-engine adaptation for Jankolock3D, not the archive's duo-1.0-proposed kit. Uses existing hitscan, melee, tether, overtime, xray and volley implementations. No new projectile, windup, flight or reveal authority is implied. Numbers are provisional, not playtested.

heroes.name: Ribbon Seraph
heroes.lore: A printer-ribbon manta. Tether a target, accelerate, scan nearby enemies and cut a broad cone.

abilities.name: Catchline
abilities.description: Hit one visible enemy for 20 damage and slow it by 30% for up to 2.4 seconds. Cover or 14m separation breaks the tether.

abilities.name: Carriage Return
abilities.description: Move 45% faster for 2.2 seconds. No invulnerability or flight; normal collision still applies.

abilities.name: Carbon Witness
abilities.description: Reveal all live enemies within 16m through cover for two seconds. Shots still stop at walls.

abilities.name: Full Width
abilities.description: Instantly cut a 50-degree cone out to 24m. Each visible enemy receives one 100-damage hit, blocked by cover. Not a projectile fan.
